notes.title: Update to 0.9.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The positioning of blocks has been improved when creating ship sprites based on the structure, and some sprites of reduced blocks have been redrawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34356406/55bb048642966faf37aa14e946d5073e718af8a4.jpg[/img]
[*] The system for calculating the volume of air in the holds has been changed. Now when building multiple blocks with Shift+LMB below the water level, checking for the presence of the ship's internal volumes is done only after the LMB is released. Also fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when calculating the volume of holds.
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in the previous update that caused the game to crash when trying to rotate a ship structure in build mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.9.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The collision masks of ships have been changed once again. In the previous update the masks were calculated according to the cut at 0 height (along the spot of contact with water), which made it impossible to hit the protruding parts of the ship. The script for generating sprites of ships has also been significantly changed (this will simplify subsequent changes in sprites and masks of bot ships, and also probably slightly increase the speed of generating sprites in the game).
[*] Completely changed the map drawing system in the "Improved map drawing" mode. Now a simple shader is used to draw the stroke along the coast in this mode.
[*] Optimized ship structure display system.
[*] The "Accelerated projectile flight" switch has been removed from the settings, now the projectiles always fly in an accelerated mode.
[*] Implemented a system that should make it easier to switch between displays using the Win + Shift + Left/Right arrow keys. In theory, when you press the Win + Shift keys, it puts the game in windowed mode, which should allow you to switch the game window to another display by the time you also press the arrow. As soon as Win+Shift is released, the game will go into full screen mode again and adapt to the resolution of the new display (after that, some visual bugs are possible until you enter / exit the menu). Unfortunately, I cannot test this system in practice, so I will be glad to receive feedback on its work.
[*] Now after pressing the "Disassemble ship" button, if it is an enemy ship, the game itself will switch to the construction of your ship.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the largest ships of the bots did not receive the correct sprite during battles.
[*] Fixed a bug related to the incorrect definition of cargo blocks on large merchant ships, which could lead to a game crash after hitting such a ship.
[*] Fixed another bug related to the incorrect location of blocks when building with "Focus on cursor height" mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.9.4
notes.content:
This update is focused on fixing bugs related to the main mechanics of the game - building ships and shelling them with cannons, but some other old bugs have also been fixed.
[list]
[*]Changed the system for generating collision masks when generating ship sprites. So using the "Generate ship sprites" setting, hits on your ship will be calculated more accurately.
[*]AI ships now use pre-generated sprites and collision masks to match their designs. This will also result in a more accurate calculation of hits against AI ships.
[*]Changed calculation of projectile trajectories in construction mode. This should reduce the chance that the cannonballs will fly past the structure of ship.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, with a certain installation method, oblique masts could remain flying in the air, having lost their support.
[*]Fixed calculation of air in the hold. Previously, due to errors in the calculation, the buoyancy of the ship could take on strange values.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which 24 pounder guns could not be correctly counted.
[*]Fixed visual shape inconsistency and collision of some land areas.
[*]Fixed bugs in the "economy" of cities, leading to an almost instantaneous accumulation of resources sufficient to spawn the largest ships. This fix led to some mixed results, so further edits to the "economy" of cities are likely.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.9.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added game resolution settings. This will probably be useful on high resolution monitors.
[*] Added damage multiplier setting. With this setting, you can change the damage that projectiles can deal. So, by increasing the damage multiplier, you can make naval battles more faster, but risky.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when trying to load a ship containing blocks of one of the new types.
[*] Reworked balance and fixed a number of bugs in boarding mode. Significantly increased the melee attack of the marines, since situations in which it can be used without risk are quite rare.
[*] Boarding cooldown increased from 5 to 60 seconds. This is done to give more weight to the actions to both continuing and escape from the boarding.
[*] Improved the appearance of the sea in the mutiny, in the boarding the sails are added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34356406/b2b4d0291b55a2f12a7832a37fab6535aa7cce0e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to 0.9.2
notes.content:
This minor update is intended to fix the display of some game menus in 4k resolutions, as well as on monitors with low resolutions.
[list]
[*] The trading menu has been redesigned in such a way that its elements in 4k resolution was displayed within the area allocated to them.
[*] The layout of the elements of the trade, quest menu and ship's log has been changed so that the menu does not extend beyond the screen on monitors with low resolution (such as 1280x1024 and 1440x900).
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.9.1
notes.content: Added 12 new blocks.

notes.title: Update to 0.9.0
notes.content:
This update is largely focused on improving the map editor, as suggested by player Sofia Pavlovna.
[list]
[*] Added the ability to change the names of cities in the map editor.
[*] Now in the map editor you can change the name of the sides and draw your own flags.
[*] Added control settings for the construct editor.
[*] Added new forms of lands.
[*] Changed some parameters of the blocks. Changed the erroneous mass of granite ramps and slopes. The weight of the machines has also been raised.
Bevels, slopes and machines have been added to the list of cargoes that large merchant ships can carry.
Due to the fact that the number of cargo options for merchant ships has increased, the likelihood of encountering a ship with gold has become less. To compensate for this, the price of gold blocks has been increased accordingly.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which cities selling gold blocks could appear on maps created in the editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.8.0
notes.content:
This update adds two new block shapes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34356406/9c2e2474f9c95cc7a599ee21b02e3537f78311b3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new types of blocks
[*] Fixed incorrect places of fastening blocks in the form of platforms
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.6
notes.content:
It is a minor update that fixes bugs introduced in the previous update.
[list]
[*] The spawn of shells when hitting a ship has been significantly reworked.
[*] Fixed a new bug that caused the game to crash when starting the editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added fog of war. Now the map does not display those places that you have not been before. A small side effect: the worlds in which you started playing before this update will also be shrouded in fog.
[*] Increased the radius of the spawn of shells when they hit the ship. Previously, shells spawning too close to the center of the ship could spawn inside the ship.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the steering wheel direction was incorrectly taken into account when creating a ship. This could lead to the fact that the ships deployed in a certain way during assembly went sideways forward, and, accordingly, their position of the guns was also determined incorrectly. Thanks to player Ishnipa for pointing out this bug.
[*] Fixed the range of boarding from the side of AI ships. In the last update, the boarding range for the player was reduced, but, as it turned out, the bots are cheating :)
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.4
notes.content:
It's a small update aimed at eliminating extremely unpleasant bugs, two of which were reported by the players RemorselssHC and Rem16, thanks to them for that :)
[list]
[*] Since the new way of drawing the coast on the map was quite resource-intensive and in some cases could cause crashes, now the old drawing is returned by default, however, the improved drawing can be enabled from the settings menu.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, playing with the ship sprite generation disabled, or on maps created by the editor, the game could crash.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the cursor height could be blocked during the construction of ships, if the inventory ran out of sails.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new block - a machine, which, like wheat field, allows you to produce resources for creating ships in captured cities.
[*] Redesigned the appearance of the world map (coastal outlining).
[*] Fixed (one more) bug due to which the game crashed when entering the editor.
[*] The area of interaction of ships with each other on the world map has been increased.
[*] Changed the number of gunners entering the boarding battle. Now, if there are more gunners on the ship than cannons, their number will be equal to the number of cannons.
[*] Reduced the area of the entrance to the boarding battle. Now, to start boarding, you will have to come close to the enemy ship.
[*] Added a button to load the most effective tactic from the previously created ones in the editing menu of mutiny tactics. Also the mutiny tactics editing menu can now be closed by pressing Esc.
[*] Added 2 achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: Upgrade to 0.7.2
notes.content:
This update is aimed at improving the gameplay in the ship building part, in accordance with the wishes of the players. It is designed to reduce the number of routine actions performed during the construction process.
[list]
[*] Added the ability to place a large number of blocks by holding Shift + LMB. Thus, if you want to make, for example, a fairly spacious deck, you no longer have to make dozens of clicks, placing each block separately. This is another idea suggested by the player with the nickname FOKK3R.
[*] Also, added the ability to erase a large number of blocks by holding Shift + RMB.
[*] Now when you place a sail block at a certain height, the space under it is also automatically filled with sails. This is done to eliminate the need to manually pass each sail block. Now it is enough to install the upper row of sails and, if necessary, cut off the lower one. Thanks for this idea to the player with the nickname Blind.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the screen to shift after installing the first block (it looked like the block appeared in the wrong place where it should have been).
[*] Fixed inaccurate display of text in guides (long lines in a guide in Chinese language, and excessively large distance between lines in a guide in English and Russian languages).
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.1
notes.content:
This update is aimed at implementing the players suggestions to eliminate a number of bugs and improve the game. Many thanks to theonetruefox and FOKK3R players for their ideas.

[list]
[*] Added a opportunity to escape from the battle. Now you can escape from the battle, for this you need to tear yourself away from the enemy ship and press the "E" button. On the map, the enemy will not be able to attack again for 5 seconds, use this time to sail away.
[*] Reworked the ship's passability in narrow areas. The collision area of the ship with the land has been reduced to 1 pixel, which allows it to pass through fairly small straits. Also, to facilitate this task, coming close to the shore, the ship will automatically turn towards the water.
[*] The current quest is now can be saved when you exit the game.
[*] Now for quests in which you need to visit this or that place, a direction designation to this place has been added.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the purchased blocks disappeared during the transition to the construction of the ship, if at that moment the trade menu was not closed.
[*] Reworked the trade menu. Now the "exit" button after purchasing the blocks has been replaced with the "load on ship" button. And if there are blocks in the inventory, a warning appears that they will disappear if they are not loaded onto the ship. Now, if the trade menu is closed by pressing "Esc" with an unfinished purchase, the purchase is completely canceled.
[*] Added scrolling of inventory by the mouse wheel.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.7.0
notes.content:
This update focuses on a new game mode. It is largely an experiment in using Steam Remote Play as a kind of multiplayer.
[list]
[*] Added "Battle" mode. This game mode is a separate battle between 2 players, each of whom controls his ship.
[*] Added enemy indicator. During the battle, if the enemy is outside the screen, a pointer will appear next to your ship, directed towards the enemy.
[*] Now, after loading blueprints, ship centered on the screen.
[*] Slightly reworked ship damage handling. The increased projectile speed mode is now automatically disabled when hitting a small ship (less than 300 blocks). Previously, small ships often did not have time to calculate all the damage, which led to the need to hit them repeatedly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.6.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now, when pirates capture five (or more) cities that did not previously belong to them, all other sides stop to fight among themselves until they reduce the number of cities captured by pirates. Hopefully this will add more challenge to late stage of game.
[*] When starting a new game, you can now select a map with geography similar to Earth. Most of the cities on this map belong to one of several major maritime empires (similar to the state of affairs in the 18th century).
[*] Added the ability to pay off if you failed to suppress the uprising on your ship. If earlier you had to replay over and over again, until victory, now if you are tired of it, you can give 1/10 of the honestly looted bablons to the crew and return to managing the ship.
[*] The speed calculation in the mutiny mode has been changed in order to make the combat speed normal on computers with high FPS. Also added to the uprising mode a timer indicating the time remaining until the end of the battle.
[*] Small land areas are now automatically deleted in the editor. This is done in order to get rid of land areas that, on the one hand, are difficult to remove manually, and on the other hand, do not make much sense.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which deleting a city in the editor could lead to a crash of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, when selecting a map for a new game, it was impossible to re-select a random generation, if one of the editor's maps was selected before.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.6.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug due to which ships could start moving during a pause.
[*] The difficulty selection screen has been redesigned so that the picture does not overlap the map options on low-resolution monitors.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which blocks of gold could be sold in cities.
[*] The generation of trade inventories for cities has been changed in such a way as to minimize situations when several slots in the same city are occupied by the same blocks.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to incorrect placement of blocks at a certain height in the "Focus at cursor height" mode.
[/list]
P.S. Thanks to the player with nickname Слепой, for telling in detail about these bugs :)

notes.title: Update to 0.6.1
notes.content:
This is another small update, mainly aimed at fixing some bugs.
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs in generating cargo transported by merchant ships. One of them caused the game to crash. The second ruled out the possibility of the spawn of gold blocks.
[*] Now, when opening the trade menu, tasks, or information about the world, a pause is turned on.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect music playback during a naval battle. Also, the music sounding after defeating an enemy ship is now played once (so as not to annoy).
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, after loading a ship from the library, the additional buoyancy received from the air in the hold was not taken into account.
[*] Added one more achievement.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.6.0
notes.content:
In this update, a new mini-game related to mutiny on the ship has been added to Block of Rum. Now, when the level of morality drops below 50%, a probability of rebellion arises (the lower the level of morality, the higher this probability). This is intended to make morality an important part of the gameplay. Since mutiny distract from the main process and some players may not like this, they can be turned off in the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34356406/a7ac8d061233e2271f08b5e6abe7f917dd093aef.jpg[/img]

Mutiny is a small tactical game in which, having gathered your squad, you need to defeat the squad of units rebelled against you. At that:
[list]
[*] The balance of power depends on the level of morality. The lower the morale, the less support points you have and the more support the rebels have (each unit requires a certain amount of support points).
[*] You cannot control any units :)
[*] But you can set tactics for each unit before the start of the battle. In fact, you can specify what your unit should do in a given situation.
[*] If you don’t set the unit tactics, it will use one of the previously invented ones. Enemy units also can use new tactics, randomly changing one of your previously invented ones. Over time, each tactic is tested in battles and gets its own performance rating (units prefer to use tactics with high ratings, but not always).
[*] Obstacles are randomly generated (or not generated, this also happens).
[*] Since there are many unpredictable and random moments in this mini-game, you can try to win as many times as you want, because losing does not a gameover.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34356406/981817e0d8371ab87ecbb04c26af067499b7153e.jpg[/img]

P.S. And also added 3 Steam achievements (probably in the future I will add a few more).

notes.title: Update to 0.5.4
notes.content:
This update has made some changes and new features regarding the cost of the various blocks. This is designed to make the gameplay in the middle stage of the game (when the player already has a good ship and a captured city) more pirated (more risky and aggressive).
[list]
[*] Now, sufficiently large merchant ships (240 blocks or more), controlled by AI, can transport some blocks as cargo. The type of cargo carried is determined randomly, but its mass cannot exceed the ship's buoyancy margin. Thus, small ships can only carry light blocks, while large ships can contain the heaviest blocks.
[*] Added block of gold. At the moment, this is the heaviest, most expensive and rare block, it can not be bought in cities and it can only be obtained as a result of victory over a fairly large merchant ship (if that ship transport it of course). This block is added to avoid a situation where the player is interested in attacking only small and weaker merchant ships, ignoring large and well-armed ones.
[*] Finally added the ability to rotate the crew blocks in all four directions and added the corresponding sprites (for sailors, gunners, marines).
[*] A new city design has been added in the form of a city with a harbor protected by a city wall.
[*] The base cost of a sand block has been significantly reduced. Its price was extremely high for one of the most common blocks, which led to a huge amount of easy money after the capture of the first city.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.5.3
notes.content:
Added the ability to interact with AI ships and traditionally fixed some bugs :)
[list]
[*] Added the ability to give orders to other ships of your faction. Now, when you come close to another ship, a menu appears with which you can choose which order to give to this ship (unless of course it also belongs to the pirates). So, you can make any allied ship accompany you or go to the nearest city.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which warships, accidentally colliding with other ships of the same faction, attacked these ships.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which ships in some cases got stuck in cities.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.5.2
notes.content:
Added calculation of air in the holds (thanks to player sharprig for pushing me with this idea). Now the internal empty spaces in the ship’s structure located below the water level add buoyancy to the ship. Also, a number of blocks can now be located below the water level, but only in the internal spaces of the ship:
- Sailors, gunners, marines (previously could not be located below water level)
- Bags of grain (previously could not be located below the water level)
- Stock of canvas (previously it was possible to have even overboard)
- Leaves (previously it could be placed even overboard)
The holds in the ships created before this update may  be bugged and not give additional buoyancy to the ship (apparently old wood gives leaks), but it can be fixed, by a couple turnings the ship 180 degrees, and then adding some block in to the hold.

notes.title: Update to 0.5.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug that appeared with the addition of an editor, causing the game to crash when trying to create a new game in some cases. Sorry for the long wait. I can not compensate for the time and nerves that you spent waiting for the correction of this bug, but soon the New Year holidays and to smooth my mistake I put 14 blocks of leaves in your inventory in this update. You will find them when you start a new game. Let your ship decorate the tree or your wallet be replenished with coins from their sale.

notes.title: Update to 0.5.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added map editor. If you want to make some kind of special map, or if you wanted to start a game in which only a few large empires are present, now you can do it.
[*]Improved ships spawn system. Now, cities controlled by AI will try to build only such ships for which they have enough resources. Thanks to the player sharprig for drawing my attention to problems with ships spawn (I hope now they disappear).
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.4.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an old bug due to which the turn of the ship without a wheel by 180 degrees did not work correctly. Now, as the coordinates of the rotation axis before setting the wheel, the coordinates of the first placed block are used.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the coordinates of the blocks placed after the ship turned 180 degrees could be shifted, which could interfere with the construction of blocks around.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to incorrect determination of the depth of rendering blocks relative to the cursor after turning the ship 180 degrees.
[*] Fixed incorrect green backlighting of such blocks as crew, guns, sails, etc., when trying to place them on a support below the water level.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.4.2
notes.content:
This is a small update that fixes some serious bugs.
[list]
[*] Changed map generation. Removed redundant check of the location of cities when loading previously generated maps, which could lead to the disappearance of cities from the map in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to the crash of the game when trying to open the list of ships.
[*] Changed the function of the button "Publish to Steam Workshop". Now it remains unavailable until the published ship can not stay on the water and develop at least some speed. This is done in order to avoid "clogging" the Steam Workshop with unfinished ships.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.4.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Changed AI behavior in battle. Now, ships driven by AI are capable of imposing boarding combat themselves, if they are confident of their superiority in manpower. Stock up on the marines :)
[*]Once again, the color palette has been redesigned. More shades are now available.
[*]Fixed a bug with generating sprites of ships, due to which horizontal stripes appeared on the masts and sails of some ships, as if they were cut into pieces.
[*]Fixed incorrect hit boxes of some buttons.
[*]Fixed a bug related to the non-loading of cities, in some cases, which led to the crash of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.4.0
notes.content:
There is only few changes in this update, but dont go away...
[list]
[*]Added support for Steam Workshop. Now you can publish your ships (and cities) in the Steam Workshop, as well as download the ships of other players. You can publish your ship directly from the game, for which the "Publish to Steam Workshop" button was added. You can get a ship created by another player by subscribing to it in the Steam Workshop. After you subscribe to the ship you are interested in the next time you start the game, this ship will appear in your drawing library. I hope the opportunity to share your designs will serve as a good motivation for further creativity :)
[*]Fixed a bug due to which when starting a new game from Steam Cloud, the ship from the previous game was loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.3.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for Steam Cloud. Now your progress in the game and blueprints can also be saved on Steam Cloud.
[*] Changed the blueprint library. Now it has an unlimited number of slots.
[*] Changed the color palette. More colors are now available.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, when there were not enough blocks to build a ship from the blueprint, some types of blocks a not displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.3.1.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now in battle, when displaying a ship based on its design, the colors in which the blocks were painted are also displayed.
[*] Added an inscription informing about the lack of blocks when trying to load a drawing, for which there are currently not enough materials. A list with the image of the missing blocks and their number is also displayed.
[*] Added cooldown between boardings. Now in case of aborting the boarding you need to wait a few seconds before you can start it again.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to incorrect saving of the city in case of loading from the blueprint. Previously, when loading a city from the blueprint, the name of the city also changed, which led to the preservation of another city corresponding to the new name.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.3.0
notes.content:
Something new added, something old fixed :)
[list]
[*] Added change of time of day. At night on the global map decreases the radius of the review. In battles, depending on the time of day, the sea can see 1 of 4 types of lighting. In addition, the change of the time of day was introduced for the implementation of some periodic processes, some of which are implemented in the following paragraphs.
[*] Added dynamic change in block prices. Each city can now have its own prices, which change over time. Prices depend on how much the city is provided with resources at the moment, as well as on the intensity of the trade of the player with the city of specific types of blocks. Probably the balance and rules of price changes will still be finalized.
[*] Added 2 blocks: bags of grain and wheat (wheat as a field). Bags with grain of all-only serve as containers for transporting wheat, which can be obtained by cutting a block of bags of grain. Wheat itself is a new kind of block, absolutely useless on the ship, but interesting for city. Each block of wheat, placing in the city  gives 1 unit production for this city. So once at day, the city will be able to receive the appropriate number of resources, regardless of trade. Wheat can only be installed on a sand block. Placing blocks in a city is possible by the following function:
[*] Added ability to manage cities belonging to the player’s faction. Now going near a city, you can click the "Manage" button. This allows not only to rebuild the city as you like, but also to choose the size and type of ship that the build in city.
[*] Improved the generation of sprites appearance of the ship based on its design. Now various bevels are displayed exactly as bevels, and not as full-fledged cubes (thus, in battle, the ship will look even more similar to what you have built).
[*] Storms added to global map. Storms affect the speed of your ship when it is in their field of action (slowing ship or accelerating depending on the direction relative to the wind).
[*] Fixed bugs leading to the rapid emergence of the largest ships immediately at the start of a new game.
1. Fixed a bug due to which at the start of a new game, cities could have resources from the previous game, which allowed them to quickly build even large ships.
2. Fixed the unjustified large profits from trade, obtained by the cities who owned of merchant ships.
3. Fixed a bug due to which some ships being built in the cities that changed the owner were considered as ships belonging to their original owner.
[*] Changed the behavior of the cursor in the mode "Focus on cursor height".
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect highlighting of the cursor in green when trying to place certain types of blocks (sails, cannons, steering wheel) below the water level.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.2.3
notes.content:
This is a small update designed to remove the next portion of the found bugs from the game.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with due to which a blocks Stock of sailcloth and Leaves did not arrive in inventory after their purchase.
[*] Fixed a bug with the presence of a button to switch information during the animation damage to the ship.
[*]  Fixed a bug due to which some buttons from the design mode could be pressed during the animation damage to the ship, although they were invisible.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.2.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] At the request of the player Object Doom added a new block - Stock of sailcloth. Cutting this block you can get 10 sails. Now, in cities, instead of sails, a Stock of sailcloth is also sold. This is done to simplify the storage of sails (including spare ones) on the ship.
[*] Added ship logbook. It contains information about your current quest, as well as information about the largest ships and empires in your world.
[*] At the request of the Object Doom player in design mode, information was added on the number of sailors, gunners, soldiers, and guns of various calibers.
[*] The number of gunners necessary to achieve a maximum rate of fire of 60 pounder guns was reduced from 4 to 3. It is assumed that a large number of guns of this caliber should be armed on the largest ships. However, a large number of gunners who are required to use such guns leads to the fact that large ships do not have room for other blocks.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the button to attack the city could be accidentally pressed through the trade menu or quests.
[*] Fixed a bug with the sounds remaining from the battles when moving from the map of the world to a battle or to the construction of a ship.
[*] Fixed a small bug due to which when you press "Z" during the construction of the effects of the shot were launched, even if the current block was not a gun.
[/list]
Hotfix: fixed critical bugs in trade/quests menu.

notes.title: Update to 0.2.1
notes.content: This is a small update, in which the construction mode has been slightly optimized and, as a result, the animation of damage to ships too.

notes.title: Update to 0.2.0
notes.content:
Many players wanted the ship in battle to match their creation, not only by the number of guns, speed and other characteristics, but also visually. This update is just for such players.
[list]
[*] Implemented sprites generation for the player's ship. Now the appearance of your ship during the battle matches the design of your ship. However, the generation of sprites can significantly increase the waiting time while saving the ship, so it can be turned off in the settings (in this case, the ship will be displayed as standart sprite, as it was before). Also note that the sprite generation system will still be improved.
[*] Added sounds of battles on the world map.
[*] Thanks to the player Object Doom fixed a bug with the lack of description in the quests to eliminate a certain ship.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the shadow of the building block galloped while changing the height of the building block.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.4
notes.content:
This is a minor update that will make this terrible building system more understandable :)
[list]
[*] A shadow has been added to allow a better understanding of the location of the building block by the x and y coordinates during the construction of the ship.
[*] Changed the number of blocks at the start of a new game (5 wooden semi-blocks were added). This is done so that novice players can load the simplest ship (Emperor) from the drawing library.
[*] Thanks to the player Покайся грешник in training added a tip on how to place the sails.
[*] The display of the mouse cursor over a ship construction is disabled, since the presence of a building block and a cursor at different heights introduced novices to confusion.
[*] Added crew morale. So far, morality does not affect anything and will be refined.
[*] Added shot sound and smoke when shooting from a cannon during construction.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.3
notes.content:
It's a small update with some fixes.
[list]
[*] At the request of the player GameYT0 in the construction of the ship added a button that allows you to lock the cursor at the height of construction. This is done to facilitate construction at high altitudes.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of descriptions of some blocks in Chinese (descriptions of some blocks were displayed in one line).
[*] Fixed a bug that led to the incorrect definition of connections for platforms of all types. This bug allowed to mount the placed horizontally platforms as you like, practically without supports.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that led to an incorrect calculation of the number of cannons of 60 pounds caliber when they were removed from the ship. This bug could lead to the unjustified defeat of a ship in a battle due to the loss of only a small number of cannons.
[*] Added a new design of cities in the form of a classic for the XVII century star-shaped fortress.
[*] Added the ability to fire from the selected cannon right during the construction of the ship. You can use this feature to test the strength of your ship.
[*] Added buttons x1, x10 and x100 into the block cutting menu. This will make cutting a large number of blocks more convenient.
[*] Added new track that playing after defeating an enemy ship during construction (instead of boarding track). This is a slightly modified track from the Block of Rum trailer.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 8 blocks: bevels, corners, platforms and semi-blocks of iron and granite.
[*] Changed the number and types of blocks getting at the start of the new game. Half blocks and deck blocks are no longer get, and the number of wooden blocks is increased, since the half blocks and deck blocks can now be obtained by sawing.
[*] Now the cities belonging to the player, after being captured by AI ships, are rebuilt to their original state. This is done for two purposes. First, to avoid an unnecessarily easy player’s capture of a previously disarmed city. Secondly, to create a threat to the valuable blocks stored in the city, if the player uses city as a kind of warehouse.
[*] Slightly modified the standard city. This is done to simplify the destruction of cannons in city, some of which were previously impossible to reach.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the menu of cutting blocks into two parts. With its help from more massive blocks, it will be possible to craft 2 other smaller blocks from the same material (for example: 2 wooden semi-blocks can be crafted from a wooden block). In this regard, the semi-blocks and deck blocks will no longer be sold in cities, and their cost is changed to make their craft from a wooden block is not profitable or unprofitable. This is done to ensure that in the future, the trading slots of cities are occupied with the most useful things, and not clogged with many blocks of different shapes.
[*] 4 new blocks has been added: a wooden bevel (a cube with a beveled corner), a wooden corner (a small triangular pyramid), a wooden platform (half of a wooden block divided horizontally or vertically) and a wooden staircase (unlike other added blocks, it is produced from deck blocks) .
[*] Navigation lights added to naval battles.
[*] In the settings, the option "Speed ​​up the flight of shells" is added, this allows you to speed up the process of hitting the shells into the ship during the battle and it is possible to save time.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.0.4.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] At the request of the player Zewds ｜ 小 聪 added translation into Chinese. I would be grateful to everyone who can point me to errors in the translation.
[*] Spawn of the cities has been reworked . Now cities can be located only at the reservoirs that have access to the outer ocean. Thanks to player Shawdawg who turned my attention to this problem.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused 60 pound cannons to look like water in the trading menu.
[*] I also tried a little more to smooth out the effects of FPS jumps on the speed of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.0.3
notes.content:
This is a small update to fix some bugs.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that did not allow to connect the blocks to the block under which there was initially no support. Thanks again to player American Beetle for helping in finding bugs  :)
[*] The speed of ships and shells, and the reloading time is now calculated on the basis of the average FPS for a certain period of time, and not from the FPS. This is done to smooth the wrong calculation of speed, in case of a sudden change in the FPS.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked all the parameters of the speed of objects in the game to make the gameplay on computers with large FPS more correct. Much thanks to player American Beetle for finding this bug!
[*] Fixed a bug associated with the increased durability of the sails of some AI ships.
[*] Partially modified user interface. A little more baroque.
[*] In the sea battle, the graphic design of the water has been reworked. More contrast has been given to the sea, more sun glare has been added, and reflections have appeared to the ships.
[*] In the sea battle, the AI ​​has been improved. Now he has become more precise and can make advance shots. Please write in community hub of Block or Rum if it has become too complicated.
[/list]
